rules: A PASS record must contain no FAIL checks.
Every numeric electrical claim must identify its test point or signal in the check_id/observed fields.
Waveforms, captures, photographs, and logs should be referenced by content hash when retained.
A missing physical measurement remains NOT_RUN or INCOMPLETE; it must not be inferred from RTL or schematic intent.
FPGA, ESP32, and sensor-board revisions must be explicitly recorded before commissioning evidence is retained.
